tour.title: Project Overview & Dual-Pathway Architecture
tour.description: Start with the README to understand the project's purpose: scraping international Physics teaching jobs, scoring with LLMs, and notifying via Telegram/Email. Then read the dual-pathway docs to learn how the job-search pipeline (Pathway 1) and the tutoring lead system (Pathway 2) work in parallel.

tour.title: Configuration Foundation & Candidate Profiles
tour.description: All configuration flows from `src/config.py` (Pydantic Settings loaded from .env). Candidate profile data in `data/profile.json` and `data/profile_tutoring.json` drives scoring relevance and proposal personalization. Build configs (pyproject.toml, package.json, tsconfig) define the dual-language toolchain.

tour.title: Pipeline Orchestrator (Pathway 1 Entry Point)
tour.description: The main job-search pipeline in `src/main.py` runs the full sequence: scrape all job boards, heuristic pre-filter, deduplicate, upsert to Supabase, LLM-score, deep-research high-scoring jobs, then notify via Telegram and Email. This is the heart of Pathway 1.

tour.title: Web Scraping Fleet
tour.description: A 10-scraper fleet built on `BaseScraper` (ABC) and `StealthBrowserScraper` (Playwright/Camoufox for anti-bot evasion). Active scrapers include TES (Next.js JSON), LinkedIn (curl_cffi fingerprint), LibyanJobs (WordPress), Basis, Dipont, GulfTalent, and stealth-browser scrapers for TopTutorJob, SearchAssociates (cookie auth), and Teacher Horizons (SPA + cookie resume).

tour.title: Stealth Browser Verification Harness
tour.description: Before every scrape session, `stealth_browser.py` validates the Camoufox fingerprint against bot.sannysoft.com using a zstd route-injection pattern. All 11 Intoli/Sannysoft tests must PASS or scraping is unsafe. The harness patches Playwright's coreBundle.js for Firefox crash handling.

tour.title: Data Storage & Deduplication
tour.description: Scraped jobs are upserted into Supabase (`job_listings` table) via `SupabaseClient`, with SQLite `DedupStore` as fallback on HTTP errors. The Supabase schema is defined in `scripts/setup_supabase.sql`. Health checks at startup ensure availability before pipeline proceeds.

tour.title: LLM Scoring Engine
tour.description: The multi-provider `LLMScorer` uses a weighted provider registry (Groq 40, NVIDIA 30, OpenRouter 20, Gemini 15) with model rotation, tenacity retry, health state machine (ACTIVE/COOLING_DOWN/DEAD), leaky-bucket chunk pacing, and a rule-based fallback (base 30). The LLM rubric scores Curriculum (0-30), Subject (0-25), Location (0-20), Salary (0-15), Housing (0-10).

tour.title: Deep Research Agent
tour.description: Jobs scored >= RESEARCH_SCORE_THRESHOLD get deep research via a ReAct-style agent (`ResearchAgent`) with DuckDuckGo web_search and Firecrawl/HTTP deep_scrape tools. Produces a `StrategicBrief` (institution_facts, strategic_alignment, recommended_angle) that feeds into cover letter generation. Falls back gracefully via `StrategicBrief.fallback()`.

tour.title: Notification Services (Pathway 1 Output)
tour.description: Jobs scored above the notification threshold are sent via Telegram (`send_telegram_alert` with scoring reasoning + cover letter attachments) and Email (`send_email_digest` via Resend API or SMTP STARTTLS). Both notify implementations pull config from `src/config.py`.

tour.title: Tutoring Lead Pathway (Pathway 2)
tour.description: The tutoring pathway runs independently: `telegram_inbound.py` handles inbound Telegram messages for tutoring leads, stores them in Supabase (`tutoring_leads` table), then the scheduled tutoring tick (`tutoring_run.py`) parses leads via LLM (`tutoring_parser.py`), scores them heuristically (`tutoring_scorer.py`), generates proposals (`tutoring_proposal.py`), and notifies back via Telegram. The heuristic scorer classifies curriculum, subject, urgency, budget, and timezone without LLM cost.

tour.title: CLI & Scheduler Entry Points
tour.description: Three entry points launch the system: `scripts/run_scheduler.py` imports `daily_run.start()` for APScheduler-based periodic pipeline execution, `scripts/run_telegram_bot.py` launches the inbound Telegram polling loop, and `python3 -m src.main` runs the pipeline once. Shell scripts (`run_scheduler.sh`, `run_telegram_bot.sh`) wrap these for systemd user services.

tour.title: Web Dashboard & Front-End Architecture
tour.description: A Next.js 14 App Router dashboard at `web/` provides reactive pages: Dashboard (`/` — job table with sortable columns, filters by source/country/curriculum/score, pagination, detail drawer), Pipeline Control (`/pipeline` — systemd status, start/stop/run, journalctl log viewer), Settings (`/settings` — threshold slider, schedule editor), and Leads (`/leads` — manual entry form, status tiles, paginated table with inline status-flip and expandable parsed brief). State managed via Zustand stores, API routes connect to Supabase and systemd.
